basic_details.job_title: IGIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 12 Junior Engineer, Administrative Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (IGIMS), Sheikhpura, Patna has 12 vacancies across 11 non-faculty posts, from Sr. Administrative Officer and Finance & Chief Accounts Officer to Junior Engineer and Assistant Public Relation Officer. Seven posts are on deputation only. Executive Engineer (Civil) and the three Junior Engineer posts are on deputation or contract. Indian citizens send the application on the prescribed proforma by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier. The last/closing date of submission is 30 days from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News.

content_sections.heading: About IGIMS
content_sections.text: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences is a medical institute at Sheikhpura, Patna-14, Bihar. The notice comes from the office of the Chief Administrative Officer, IGIMS. Copies went to the Hon'ble Health Minister-cum-Chairman, Board of Governors, IGIMS and to the Secretary, Health Department, Govt. of Bihar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be on the prescribed proforma. The proforma is printed on page 9 of the notice and can also be downloaded from the Institute website www.igims.org . Send the application through Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier. The notice does not print a separate postal address for applications. The Institute's address on the letterhead is Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sheikhpura, Patna-14 (Bihar). The fee is paid by Demand Draft payable to the Director, IGIMS, Patna. It is non refundable. Candidates employed in a Government Department or with any other employer must submit their application through proper channel. They may send an advance copy of the application, with the educational qualification and experience certificates, so that it reaches IGIMS on or before the last date. In that case, the No Objection Certificate issued by the employer must be submitted at the time of interview. Candidates who do not submit it will not be considered for selection.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Recent photograph affixed on the application form. Proof of age (date of birth). Self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates. Experience details (institution, post, period, nature of duties) as asked in the form; employed candidates sending an advance copy attach the educational qualification and experience certificates. SC/ST candidates: caste certificate issued by the Circle Officer of the respective District/Circle of Bihar, along with the Domicile Certificate. BC/EBC candidates claiming reservation: caste certificate with the certificate of exemption from Creamy Layer issued by the Circle Officer of the respective District/Circle of Bihar, along with the Domicile Certificate. Demand Draft for the application fee, payable to the Director, IGIMS, Patna. No Objection Certificate from the employer (employed candidates), to be submitted at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies across 11 posts, including 02 Accounts Officer posts and one post each for the other ten designations. The notice calls the vacancies indicative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last/closing date of submission is 30 days from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News. The notice does not print a calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IGIMS Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Junior Engineer (Civil) and (Mechanical) need a Diploma in the respective branch; on contract, they also need 5 years' experience. Junior Engineer (Bio-Medical) needs a first class Diploma in Electronics/Bio-Medical Engineering with 02 years experience in a Medical Institution or reputed organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 56 years for deputation posts, as on the last date of submission of application. On contract, it is 62 years for Executive Engineer (Civil), and between 18-30 years for the three Junior Engineer posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IGIMS non-faculty posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Pay Matrix Level 6 (₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400) to Level 11 (₹67,700 - ₹2,08,700). On contract, the consolidated remuneration is ₹67,700/- for Executive Engineer (Civil) and ₹35400/- for each Junior Engineer post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for Unreserved & Other candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST/EBC/Female candidates. It is paid by Demand Draft payable to the Director, IGIMS, Patna, and is non refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the proforma from www.igims.org and fill it in neatly typed. Attach the Demand Draft and certificates, then send it by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier within 30 days of the Employment News publication.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the IGIMS deputation period?
faq.answer: The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed 03 years for most posts. For Public Relation Officer, it shall ordinarily not exceed 04 years.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets age relaxation for the IGIMS Junior Engineer contract posts?
faq.answer: For Junior Engineer (Mechanical) and Junior Engineer (Bio-Medical) on contract, EBC candidates and female candidates of all categories get 03 years. The relaxation is given to candidates of Bihar Domicile only.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need an NOC to apply to IGIMS?
faq.answer: Yes. Employed candidates must apply through proper channel, and the employer's No Objection Certificate must be submitted at the time of interview. Candidates without it will not be considered for selection.
